types.green_up: first of 3 covered dates after bare or water
types.senescence_harvest: first of 2 non-covered dates after cover
types.cutting: hay: cover drops and is back within 45 days (not a harvest)

reference_note: s2_scl_reference = the same logic on this field's Sentinel-2 SCL classes (>= 80% of clear pixels); agreement, not ground truth
estimate_note: Estimated: rule-based transitions from the S2/Landsat calendar (backend/field) and the two-class estimate; no machine-learning detector was run on this BC field. s2_scl_reference = the same logic on this field's Sentinel-2 scene classes (>= 80% of clear pixels): agreement, not ground truth.
